strict parent order and strict one-coordinate product monotonicity
exact parity and allowed-residue product rules modulo 9
seed-3 availability is exact for every reducible even output
2*3-1 is finite and every nonseed odd vertex has one seed-2 predecessor

top_extension_certificate.statement: Every size-n model extends to size n+1 by changing old overflow n to n+1, adding an even splitless residue-0 vertex n, and making all pairs incident to n overflow. All old stages, roots, and counts persist.
top_extension_certificate.consequence: Infeasibility at size n for every d excludes every smaller size.
